title: Create README.md and LICENSE files
description: Develop essential project documentation files for user information and legal compliance.
details:
# README and LICENSE Implementation

## README.md Creation
- Write clear project overview and purpose
- Include installation instructions for different platforms
- Add basic usage examples with code snippets
- Document dependencies and requirements
- Include contribution guidelines and contact information

## LICENSE File
- Select appropriate open-source license (MIT recommended)
- Include full license text with correct year and copyright holder
- Add license notice at the top of source files
- Document license choice in README

## Implementation Steps
- Research similar crystallography libraries for README structure
- Create template with standard sections (Overview, Installation, Usage, etc.)
- Ensure license compatibility with dependencies
- Add badges for build status, version, and license

## Content Guidelines
- Keep README concise but informative
- Use code blocks for installation and usage examples
- Include links to more detailed documentation
- Properly format Markdown for readability
